facts.fact: 猎影兽是她自己的主意，可这主意在文武庙里坐着时显得周密得多。
facts.anchor: It had been Kiamling’s idea to hunt the shadow monster, but the plan had seemed more watertight in the comforts of Man Mo temple.

facts.fact: 站在高处，海港里的船小得像折纸，她开始犯疑。
facts.anchor: Here, where the ships in the harbour looked like nothing more than folded paper, she started having her doubts.

facts.fact: Hoi 用关刀在垂藤和厚灌木里劈出一条路。
facts.anchor: Hoi used his guandou to cut a path through the hanging vines and thick undergrowth.

facts.fact: 橡胶树上留着被爪子剜出的痕。
facts.anchor: Claw marks gouged into the rubber trees.

facts.fact: Jingling 蹲下把手掌张在爪痕上，张到最大也够不上那个掌印。
facts.anchor: Jingling squatted and splayed her fingers over them, but even her widest stretch could not match the handspan.

facts.fact: 死掉的鼠鸟被掏空、干瘪失水，气被吸尽。
facts.anchor: Their bodies hollowed out, shrivelled and devoid of moisture. Drained of all their qi.

facts.fact: Hoi 拎着死鼠尾巴问她，凭什么断定影兽在这上头。
facts.anchor: “Kiamling, exactly how do you know the shadow beast is up here?”

facts.fact: 她坦白：起火那夜祖母被掳，她追到此处，有一道门，门关上了，她太怕，没敢过去。
facts.anchor: “The night of the fires, when it snatched Por Por, I chased it up here. There was a doorway, but it closed. I… I let it close. I was too afraid to go through.”

facts.fact: Hoi 一根手指戳在她额头上，弹了一下。
facts.anchor: Hoi plonked a finger on her forehead and flicked her.

facts.fact: 他说听出她那颗莽撞脑子里还留了点自保，倒是松了口气。
facts.anchor: “I’m relieved to hear there’s a bit of self-preservation in your utterly reckless brain.”

facts.fact: Hoi 笑得有点歪，说那夜他在一只花艇上。
facts.anchor: “I was in one of the flower boats,” Hoi said with a crooked smile.

facts.fact: Archie 反问谁会承认自己去过太平山街的妓院。
facts.anchor: “Who is going to admit visiting brothels in Tai Ping Shan Street?” Archie said.

facts.fact: 他一向被人忽略，注意力落到他身上反而不自在。
facts.anchor: Used to being ignored, he found the attention on him discomforting.

facts.fact: 说实话，他们要的是她走开。
facts.anchor: Truth be told, they wanted her to go away.

facts.fact: 她再喊，Archie 不见、Hoi 不见，Jingling 也不见了。
facts.anchor: Kiamling called again. No sign of Archie. No Hoi. Jingling had disappeared now too.

facts.fact: 前方那抹紫色到底不是 Jingling，是一丛紫花。
facts.anchor: It was not Jingling after all, but a patch of violet flowers.

facts.fact: 身后左轮响了一声，又一声。
facts.anchor: A revolver fired behind her. Once. Twice.

facts.fact: Archie 说它就在这儿，他看见它的眼睛在发光。
facts.anchor: “It’s here. I saw its eyes glowing.”

facts.fact: 那团灰色太小，不像尸首，是 Archie 的外套。
facts.anchor: No, thank Chung Kwai, it was too small to be a body. It was Archie’s jacket.

facts.fact: 阴影里，Archie 举起左轮对准 Hoi。
facts.anchor: From the shadows, Archie raised his revolver and pointed it at Hoi.
